items.title: Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Saturday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)
items.summary: Search teams have recovered 734 bodies after the Bhote Koshi floods, while about 2,500 people remain unaccounted for, including over 400 foreigners. More than 8,000 people have been rescued so far.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Saturday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)

items.title: Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: Flash floods struck the Bhote Koshi River on 26 August, and teams have recovered 626 bodies while about 2400 people are still missing. Over 4450 people have been rescued so far, including more than 187 foreign nationals, with searches continuing in the affected areas.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal’s Bhote Koshi River on 26 August, killing many people and damaging homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure. Rescue teams have recovered 538 bodies so far, while hundreds of locals and tourists remain missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026

items.title: FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang
items.summary: Rescue teams and helicopters reached the mudslide area at Gyirong Port after it struck Wednesday morning. As of Thursday morning, three people had been killed, 558 were still missing, and two villagers had been pulled out.
items.citation: Xinhua (Gyirong / Tibet side) — FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026
items.summary: A flash flood hit Nepal’s Bhote Koshi River on 26 August, destroying homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure. Rescue teams have recovered 359 bodies so far, while 596 people from 33 countries remain missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026

items.title: NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood
items.summary: Nepal's foreign ministry has opened an emergency room to help with foreign nationals affected by the Rasuwa floods. Call or message +977-9744441227 or +977-9744441228 between 7am and 10pm.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood

items.title: Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation
items.summary: India's foreign ministry opened a 24-hour control room in Delhi for the Nepal floods. Families can reach the listed phone and WhatsApp numbers for updates.
items.citation: MEA press release — Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods struck Nepal's Bhote Koshi River this morning, damaging homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure. So far 72 bodies have been recovered and 403 people from 25 countries are reported missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026

items.title: NESRA FloodWatch — Rasuwa / Bhotekoshi situation brief
items.summary: There's an independent site using satellite images to show flood impacts and access in the Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi areas. It recommends following official updates from DHM, NDRRMA, and local authorities.
items.citation: NESRA — FloodWatch Rasuwa 2026

items.title: NDRRMA rescue coordination portal
items.summary: The NDRRMA rescue portal and SETU platform carry the latest coordination updates on the Bhotekoshi and Rasuwa flash flood. Families looking for status should check those official sources rather than social media.
items.citation: NDRRMA — rescue portal (ndrrma.gov.np/np/rescue)

items.title: Nepal Police official found and missing lists
items.summary: Nepal Police keeps the official lists of people missing or found after the floods, along with any unidentified remains. Only they can confirm someone's status, not social media or other sites.
items.citation: Nepal Police UDB — udb.nepalpolice.gov.np

items.title: Embassy of India, Kathmandu — assistance for Indian nationals
items.summary: The Indian embassy in Kathmandu is working with Nepalese authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals caught in the flash floods around Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi. Families can reach the MEA control room in Delhi or the embassy on WhatsApp for help.
items.citation: Embassy of India, Kathmandu
